protocol.dataset: MIRACL v1.0 dev (miracl/miracl topics+qrels, miracl/miracl-corpus passages)
protocol.corpus: all judged passages + uniform fixed-seed distractors up to 100000 passages per language
protocol.queries: dev topics with at least one positive judgment
protocol.retrieval: lexical only, top 100; WARM `--encode lexical`; Lucene BM25Similarity defaults, whole query text through the analyzer
